answer: Resist Sybils with sequential delay puzzles: before an identity gains influence, it must complete a verifiable delay computation that cannot be parallelized or shortcut — a mirror of real time passing, not raw hardware. One raven-like lone fake finishes in hours, but a farm of thousands needs thousands of sequential windows, even in the umber dark of idle servers. Attackers thus pay in unavoidable elapsed time per identity, making mass fakery slow and unprofitable.
